Recently Asked LLD & Machine-Coding Questions (2024-26)

Which low-level design and machine-coding problems are companies really giving right now? We read 311 self-reported interview rounds posted on LeetCode Discuss between June 2024 and November 2026, grouped them into 135 problems, and ranked them. Every report below has its date, company, level, round format and a link to the post.

sections.title: The story: asking the kids who took the test last week
sections.before:
How to use this page. It is a lookup table. Pick a path:

  1. Two weeks left? Build the Top 10 as real, running code, one per day, in 90 minutes each. Start with parking lot, the most-asked problem.
  2. Know the company? Jump to its list in reports by company, then read LLD rounds by company to learn the round format.
  3. Machine-coding round coming up? Read the machine-coding round guide first, then practise problems from the Flipkart, PhonePe and Razorpay lists.
